name: r6f_ChannelSetVolume
notes: set the volume and mode (bits 0..1) of a sound channel; bit 6 marks a nonzero volume; the original builds the bit with setne/and 1/shl 6 where modern cl selects 0x40 directly

name: r6f_ObjSetSound
notes: store the 0x18-byte sound settings block of an object (struct copy); the original addresses the destination from o+0x1B8 (+4..+0x14) where modern cl uses the absolute field offsets

name: r6f_PassSetEmit
notes: emit every pass of a pass set into a display list: its commands (or the default 0x47 command); pre/post hooks and unless disabled the state block with its callbacks

name: r6f_GridSettle
notes: for every cell of g run 0x000ED4C0 on the cell and its links; then spin 0x000ED520 on every cell and link until done; calls 0x000853B0 and 0x00085430 with EDI=g

name: r6f_GridRefresh
notes: for every cell of g run 0x000ED590 on the cell and its links; then 0x000ED5D0 on every cell and link; calls 0x000853B0 and 0x00085430 with EDI=g

name: r6f_GridReset
notes: wait for 0x000EE240 then for every grid cell except column 8 run 0x000ED600; 0x000ED560 and 0x000ED4F0 (one pass each) on the cell and its links; calls 0x000853B0 and 0x00085430 with EDI=g

name: r6f_CellListSettle
notes: the four grid passes (0x000ED4C0; spin 0x000ED520; 0x000ED590; 0x000ED5D0) over an explicit list of cells

name: r6f_CellListReset
notes: reset a list of cells: 0x00033BF0(c -1) on every cell and link; wait for 0x000EE240; then the 0x000ED600/0x000ED560/0x000ED4F0 passes

name: r6f_PendingPopEarliest
notes: take the pending entry with the smallest time (below 1000000) from the list at 0x003ED27C: copy its table position into dst and release it

name: r6f_BoxCalcMax
notes: regargs: o=EBX. Compute once (flag 4) the largest value among the type-1 children of o

name: r6f_BoxClampToMax
notes: clamp the values of all children of o to its maximum; calls 0x00089460 with EBX=o

name: r6f_SceneStartDue
notes: start every task of the scene whose time has come and whose channel bits the scene mask enables (kind 12 skipped while mask bit 0x400 is set); the original tests bit 0x400 as test byte [p+1];4 (a memory high-byte test that the checker does not normalise) where modern cl tests the dword with 0x400

name: r6f_SceneUpdate
notes: advance a running scene (bit 8) unless paused (bit 9) and mark it finished at the end; start due tasks; dispatch children and step the reference list; bits 8 and 9 tested by the original as shr 8/shr 9 then test 1 and by modern cl as test 0x100/0x200 (same bits)

name: r6f_TaskSoundStep
notes: sound task step: while the reference is shown (0x100) and not muted (0x200) play sound id+50; else clear the playing flag

name: r6f_TaskBlendKeys8
notes: blend the eight key channels of t's work with the next node of the same kind and object (or itself) into the animation object; when looping clear bit 0 of the leading type-2 nodes of ref

name: r6f_TaskBlendKeys9
notes: blend the nine key channels of t's work with the next node of the same kind and object (or itself) into t's active target after refreshing its effect; else clear flag 2

name: r6f_TaskLinkMat
notes: link the material of t's active target to that of the type-8 node of x with the keys in t's work; else clear flag 2

name: r6f_SceneTrackMode
notes: while the scene time lies between the first two kind-1/1 nodes switch the scene to the first node mode (event 3 or 4 on change) and run 0x0008BFD0

name: r6f_TaskMergeEqual
notes: merge a node into a list; same-kind nodes that compare equal (0x0008B1A0) are removed or released

name: r6f_TaskClone
notes: make a new task node with a copy of src's work block via the kind's copy handler

name: r6f_TaskInitWork
notes: allocate and clear the work block of kind/sub for a task and run the kind's init handler

name: r6f_TaskCompare
notes: compare two task nodes with the compare handler of b's kind

name: r6f_TaskFindKey
notes: from n on find the first node whose work matches the key in all mask bits (2 time; 4 kind; 8 sub; 0x10 object)

name: r6f_TaskFindKind
notes: find the next node of a kind/sub from t (key search through 0x0008B210)

name: r6f_TaskOrder
notes: order two task nodes by time; kind; object id; sub and the word at +0x0C (-1/0/1; nodes without work sort last)

name: r6f_TaskFreeChain
notes: free a chain of task nodes with children; references and work blocks

name: r6f_TaskRebindRefs
notes: re-resolve each reference and swap the new object into the work blocks that used the old one

name: r6f_TaskMerge
notes: merge a node into a list; same-kind nodes accepted by pred are removed or released

name: r6f_TaskHeapsInit
notes: clear two task globals and set the heaps of the seven task slots

name: r6f_TaskTimedTarget
notes: once the object's start time is reached set its target from this node's time and the next matching node's time

name: r6f_TaskCopyMat
notes: copy the material of t's active target into the type-8 node with the same id fields under x and restart it; else clear flag 2

name: r6f_DListSwap
notes: swap two nodes of a doubly linked list (adjacent or not)

name: r6f_TaskFindMatch
notes: find the first node whose match bits against ref (2 same type; 4 same target) contain the mask

name: r6f_TaskSortList
notes: bubble-sort a sibling chain by type then target between two stack sentinel nodes

name: r6f_TaskNew
notes: create a task node of a type (heap 5) for a work block and run the type's init handler; modern cl merges the two adjacent byte stores (+0x22 and +0x23) into one word store

name: r6f_TaskCopyNode
notes: copy a task node (new node of the same type and work; copy handler)

name: r6f_RefListStep
notes: run the step handler of the first entry's task; pop it on a result or drop it when finished

name: r6f_ProcPlayIdSound
notes: process step: when running play the sound for the reference id (fixed sound 4 for a set of ids else id+50) and go to state 4

name: r6f_ProcOpenStage
notes: process step: first time reset the task heaps and pool sizes; switch the texture group and open the stage reference; then state 3

name: r6f_TaskBlendKeys
notes: find up to two kind-13/2 nodes driving the same animation object as t and blend their four key channels into it

name: r6f_BlobMerge
notes: merge blob b into blob a (task list; node chain with duplicate removal); rebind references and free the removed nodes

name: r6f_BlobLoad
notes: load a script blob: copy the 0x20-byte header then parse the node chain and the task list; bytes used or error

name: r6f_TaskArgThree
notes: argument parser: three words into +0x24/+0x2C/+0x30; returns 12 or -1; the original walks the argument pointer (+4 +4 then [p-4]) where modern cl uses offsets 4/8 and it selects 12/-1 with setge/dec/and/add

name: r6f_TaskAnimAttach
notes: attach the animation entry of the task's id and optionally set the part blend from the scene time since the task start (x0.5; not negative); without an entry drop the part; float compare operands swapped (comiss now;start jae vs comiss start;now jbe)

name: r6f_TaskMatHandler
notes: material task handler: state 1 requests a load; state 3 loads the material of ref (retry counter) or refreshes it; calls 0x0008E340 with EDI=((R6eAnimRef*)t->p28)->i5C EBX=n

name: r6f_TaskSyncSpeed
notes: task handler: while the reference shows (0x400) sync the task; refresh and set the animation speed from its ramp (1.0 without one); 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata

name: r6f_TaskPickFreeId
notes: task handler: mark idle and take the lowest id not used by the type-7 nodes of ref (default the process reference)

name: r6f_TaskFxStart
notes: task handler: for an idle task without an effect list allocate its 0xF8-byte block and start the list for a->i04

name: r6f_TaskFxStop
notes: task handler: for an idle task with an effect list free its block and the list

name: r6f_TaskSaveSlots
notes: when flag 2 is set copy field +0x24 of each live 0x48-byte slot and the 0xB0-byte block into the task's holder; unsigned count zero guard emitted as jbe by the original and folded into the loop test by modern cl

name: r6f_TaskShareMat
notes: regargs: t=EDI x=stack. Hand the task's material to each type-8 node of x with the same id fields then release it; two bit tests on the same xor merged into one masked test (0xFFFFF00) by modern cl; the original's 0xFFF00 mask lies inside the image range so the checker lists it as data

name: r6f_ModelSetApply
notes: apply v to every model of a model set; unsigned count zero guard emitted as jbe by the original and folded into the loop test by modern cl

name: r6f_ModelRecName
notes: regargs: o=EAX buf=stack. Format the stage id plus model id and size of a model record into buf

name: r6f_ModelListFree
notes: free every model record of a list (handles; model; record)

name: r6f_ModelListGet
notes: find the model record with keys a and b in a list; create and add it when missing; NULL when it cannot be loaded

name: r6f_KeyArraysInit
notes: set up four growable key arrays (16-byte records; 4-byte keys); same fields addressed from a different base: the original walks a pointer to +0x04 of each record and modern cl one to +0x10
